name: Should I paint over mobile home wall batten strips or remove them first?

mainEntity.name: Should I paint over mobile home wall batten strips or remove them first?

acceptedAnswer.text: Painting batten strips or removing them depends on your budget, timeline, and aesthetic goals. Leaving the strips in place and painting directly over them is the fastest, most cost-effective option, though the panel seams remain visible. If you want a smooth, modern drywall look, the plastic or wood strips must be removed. The recessed seams underneath require filling, taping, and skimming with joint compound before priming and painting. This conversion requires significantly more labor and time, and because mobile homes shift during seasonal freeze-thaw cycles, seams must be taped properly to avoid hairline cracking later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Leaving batten strips in place is faster and budget-friendly, while removing them requires taping and skimming the seams for a smooth finish, which takes more labor and prep time.
